room_not_ready.message: The room is not ready yet: there is no current slot.

unknown_climate.message: The climate entity {entity_id} does not exist.

room_not_assigned.message: The room {entity_id} is not assigned to a program.

temperature_out_of_range.message: The temperature {temperature} is outside the limits of {entity_id} ({min}-{max} °C).

stale_day.message: The display shows {day_kind}, but today is {today_kind}: nothing was changed.

conflict.message: The program changed since the display read it (revision {revision} instead of {base_revision}): nothing was changed.

day_locked.message: The bands of {day_kind} contain a setting that cannot be written in the text (for example an unusual preset name or a temperature with more than two decimals). Change this day in the editor.

create_program.name: Create program
create_program.description: Create a weekly program and return its id.

week.name: Week
week.description: Seven lists (Monday first) of bands {start, end, mode, temperature, preset}, times as HH:MM. In each band temperature and preset are optional, but heat and cool need at least one of them; off takes neither.

holiday.name: Holiday
holiday.description: List of bands used on public holidays.

update_program.name: Update program
update_program.description: Change name, week or holiday bands of a program; assigned rooms apply the change.

delete_program.name: Delete program
delete_program.description: Delete a program that has no rooms.

assign.name: Assign program
assign.description: Assign a room to a program.

unassign.name: Unassign room
unassign.description: Remove the program from a room and stop controlling it.

pause.name: Pause room

set_manual.name: Set manually
set_manual.description: Force a mode, a preset and/or a temperature until the end of the current slot. For heat and cool at least one of preset and temperature is required; both are ignored for off.

climate_entity_id.name: Thermostat
climate_entity_id.description: The climate entity of the room.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature (optional if a preset is given).

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset of the thermostat (one of its preset_modes, for example home or eco). Sent before the temperature.

resume_auto.name: Resume automatic
resume_auto.description: Drop the manual override and apply the current slot.

climate_entity_id.name: Thermostat
climate_entity_id.description: The climate entity of the room.

set_day.name: Set today's bands
set_day.description: Replace the bands you set for today in the program of a room. The program is shared: every room that uses it changes. The automatic off bands are recalculated. Refused with stale_day if today is not day_kind.

climate_entity_id.name: Thermostat
climate_entity_id.description: The climate entity of the room.

day_kind.name: Day
day_kind.description: The day being edited: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun or holiday. It must be today's day for the room.

bands.name: Bands
bands.description: Bands separated by semicolons, each HH:MM-HH:MM mode [temperature] [preset=name], for example 07:00-22:00 heat 20.5; 22:00-24:00 off. Empty means no bands.

base_revision.name: Base revision
base_revision.description: The revision of the program the caller last read (third field of the room sensor's edit_info). If the program has changed since, the call fails with conflict and nothing is written. Optional: without it the last writer wins.
